name: Context.dev

team.summary: Built by Yahia, a solo founder (YC S26) who previously worked at Amazon and Sunrun, co-founded StockAlarm.io and essense.io (both acquired), and built knifegeek.io and Brand.dev before expanding into Context.dev.

product.summary: An API and developer platform (Context.dev) that extracts structured data, clean Markdown, rendered HTML, screenshots, and brand intelligence (logos, colors, fonts, socials) from any website or domain using JSON schemas for AI agents and developer products.

market.summary: AI infra and dev tools market focused on web data retrieval, scraping, RAG grounding, and brand enrichment for developers building AI agents, chatbots, and onboarding flows.

risks.risk: High competition in a crowded web scraping and retrieval market with many established players and well-funded competitors like Firecrawl, Exa, and Tavily.
Website blocking, anti-bot mechanisms, and pushback from site owners regarding server-side scraping and crawler citizenship.
Potential risk of new frontier models natively performing web fetching and structured extraction without intermediaries.

founder_depth.why: Solo founder with multiple prior acquisitions (StockAlarm.io, essense.io) and a strong history of shipping relevant scraping and brand data products (knifegeek.io, Brand.dev).

shipping_evidence.why: Fully functional API with public docs, SDKs across multiple languages (TypeScript, Python, Ruby, Go, PHP), self-serve onboarding, free tier, and active early customers like Mintlify and SiteGPT.

demand_signal.why: 119 points and 86 comments on Hacker News, featuring active discussion, positive customer feedback, and notable production users scaling with the product.

defensibility.why: Operating in a heavily commoditized and crowded web scraping/retrieval API category where differentiation primarily rests on execution speed, caching, and feature packaging rather than deep technical moats.

analysis.verdict_reason: The founder has a proven track record of shipping and exiting previous products, and has rapidly iterated from Brand.dev into a broader web context API with real early customers and strong execution speed.
would_change_my_mind: Evidence of proprietary anti-bot or proxy infrastructure that permanently solves high-value data access better than competitors.
Rapid acceleration of net-negative churn and enterprise logo expansion despite heavy market crowding.
Demonstrated structural moat preventing commodity pricing pressure from well-funded rivals.
data_gaps: Exact current ARR or MRR numbers
Detailed metrics on API success rates against advanced cloudflare/turnstile protections
GitHub repository stats and open-source contributions
